result.summary: Found 1 major visual issue: a loading spinner overlay is rendered on top of the Tokumaru Ramen Bar food image, making the card appear as if it is stuck mid-load or broken.

issues.description: A circular loading/progress spinner is visibly overlaid in the center of the Tokumaru Ramen Bar image in the 'Popular right now' section. This makes the card look broken or unfinished, as if the image failed to load or the loader never disappeared.
issues.suggestion: Ensure the spinner is removed once the image finishes loading, or replace the spinner with a subtle skeleton/placeholder that doesn't overlap the actual food photo.
